events.body:
## Context

The README jobs table lists 4 jobs but `src/jobs.js` has 10 (missing blt-pool, leaf, lettuce, monitor, sizzle, netguardian). `wrangler.toml` still binds `GSOC` to blt-gsoc although no job has used it since 2026-10-18.

## What to do

1. Regenerate the README table from `JOBS` in `src/jobs.js`.
2. Remove the `GSOC` service binding from `wrangler.toml`.
3. Add a test in `test/cron.test.js` that fails if wrangler.toml declares a binding no job uses.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Table lists every job
- [ ] `GSOC` binding removed
- [ ] New test passes

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-cron
```

---
